name: vfx-engine
description: A small particle/screen-effects engine (burst, confetti, shake, flash, glow...) for #html Volt games, plus a thin Volt-side API to trigger them.

snippets.label: VFX engine (particles, shake, flash, glow)
snippets.description: Drop-in canvas particle engine + CSS, with burst()/confetti()/shake()/flash()/glow() Volt functions ready to call from your own game logic.
